name: Terminal
notes: Frontend implementation lives in pantheon-ui (src/desktop/apps) until the UI phase moves it here; this manifest is the definition.

actions.name: run
actions.description: Type a command into this window’s PTY and press Enter.

params.command: command line without a trailing newline

actions.name: input
actions.description: Send raw input into this window’s PTY without appending Enter.

actions.name: interrupt
actions.description: Send Ctrl-C to this window’s PTY.
